sources.title: Fathi7ma/tiny-stories-gpt2 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: 🧠 Model Overview This model is a fine-tuned version of GPT-2 (small) trained on the TinyStories dataset — a large collection of short, simple stories for children. The goal of this project is to create a lightweight, fun, and creative story generator that can produce short, imaginative stories from user prompts.
